value.author: cavalryAstro
value.layerInfo: Bends the flat NASA sky imagery onto the camera's stereographic view. CavalryAstro adds and connects it for you when you build imagery.

viewScale: Set every frame by CavalryAstro: how much the imagery source is shrunk.
viewOffset: Set every frame by CavalryAstro: the centre of the imagery source's visible area.
gain: Set from Imagery · Brightness in the Sky controls.
softness: Set from Imagery · Softness in the Sky controls.
